name: mutable
source:
export local value=1
value=2
assert(value==2)

name: uninitialized
source:
export local value
assert(value==nil)
value=3
assert(value==3)

name: multi
source:
export local a,b=1,"two"
assert(a==1 and b=="two")

name: typed
source:
export local value: number=1
assert(value==1)

name: const
source:
export const value=3
assert(value==3)

name: function
source:
export function double(value: number): number return value*2 end
assert(double(3)==6)

name: recursive
source:
export function down(value: number): number if value==0 then return 0 end return down(value-1) end
assert(down(3)==0)

name: function-body-return
source: export function get(): number if true then return 3 end return 4 end

name: shadow-before
source:
local value=1
export local value=value+1
assert(value==2)

name: shadow-after
source:
export local value=1
local value="other"
value="changed"
assert(value=="changed")

name: function-shadow
source:
local function get(): number return 1 end
export function get(): number return 2 end
assert(get()==2)

name: contextual-export
source:
local export=1
export=2
local t={export=export}
assert(t.export==2)

name: contextual-name
source:
export local export=1
assert(export==1)

name: trivia
source:
export -- owned
local value=1
assert(value==1)

return value
